title: Fact-generated interpreter VM — Deegen two-tier paper alignment
constraints: quench-runtime owns JavaScript semantics; quench-node owns only the Node host boundary
Benchmark fixtures and workload-specific kernels are not production VM semantics
Every fact is Proven, Guarded, or Unknown; every fast path (interpreter, IC, JIT) has complete fallback semantics
Generated code is derived from one declaration; handwritten code is limited to irreducible behavior
Every task belongs to exactly one theme

Performance measurements are evidence: any optimization admitted here must generalize to any JavaScript program with the same runtime shape, not be sized to one fixture's numbers (see docs/benchmark-integrity.md)

Deegen (arXiv:2411.11469) is a two-tier design: interpreter + baseline JIT + tier-switching. No optimizing JIT, no deoptimization protocol — the paper doesn't build either. See docs/deegen-alignment.md.

Nail the Deegen implementation completely (tasks 027-037, every audited-absent mechanism in docs/deegen-alignment.md closed) BEFORE any benchmark-driven optimization work outside this backlog. No fixture-specific tuning (e.g. Splay/Richards helpers) or new performance work starts until docs/deegen-alignment.md's status table has zero Absent/Partial rows and task 037's closing verification is recorded.
The existing ExecutionTier::Optimizing scaffold is kept as a beyond-paper extra optimization layer, not described as the paper's (nonexistent) optimizing tier

completed_slices: 001-026 (prior queue, all themes deegen_codegen/quickjs_perf/benchmark_integrity/copy_patch_jit): single-source vm_op! catalog, ordinary interpreter, bounded quickening/inline-cache state, compact tagged values, hashed shape/atom lookup, copy-and-patch region-stencil baseline JIT tier, callee-directed continuation dispatch. See git history and docs/architecture-evidence.md for evidence; superseded task files removed once this plan closed the gap in docs/deegen-alignment.md.

deegen_full_jit.goal: Complete quench's alignment with the Deegen paper's (arXiv:2411.11469) actual two-tier design, per the audited gap table in docs/deegen-alignment.md: commit/verify existing tier-up+OSR work, then close each audited-absent mechanism (slow-path outlining, register pinning, tag register optimization, true bytecode quickening, JIT-side SMC IC + inline slab, hot-cold splitting, stencil region breadth), then verify the extra beyond-paper Optimizing tier and do full closing verification.
